dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't you think that's a bit much to take with you?

dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: Of course not. Internally, we have guidelines for gear to keep the overly cautious folks from stuffing their pockets with things they don't need.

dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: That said, while I always stick to the guidelines, I do tend to bring just a little extra when I can... After all, you never know when something might come in handy.
